SELECT
FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.status = #{q.status}
AND a.featured = 1
AND a.user_id = #{q.authorId}
AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_tags atg JOIN tags t ON t.id = atg.tag_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE atg.article_id = a.id AND t.slug = #{q.tag} )
ORDER BY a.featured DESC, COALESCE(a.published_at, a.created_at) DESC, a.id DESC
